evidence_log.source: SK Hynix Q1 2026 earnings + Samsung HBM4 GTC 2026 announcement + Mirae HBM allocation analysis
evidence_log.summary: SK Hynix retains 70% Nvidia HBM4 share; Samsung captured ~28-30% Vera Rubin. HBM gross margin ~80% SK Hynix vs ~52% Samsung. HBM4E qualification tied. Partially fired ~10% EPS impact.
Micron 18% global HBM4 share, excluded from Vera Rubin primary SKUs. Growth source attributed to Samsung's portion not SK Hynix's.
